extracted.name: Eggless fudge brownie cake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Eggless fudge brownie cake.
ingredient_lines: Half cup milk cold as needed to mix
instruction_lines: Mix sugar and curd and let it come down at room temperature then add everything except melted chocolate
Add everything and mixwell just in one direction and add melted chocolate then milk to make smooth thick batter
Place parchment sheet and transfer batter in baking pan
Bake at 400°c for 25 minutes and let it cool down at room temperature and serve with vanilla ice cream
Enjoy eggless so soft so fudge chocolate brownie cake
